content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

General rule: aim for 1.6–2.2 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight daily. That's the sweet spot for muscle growth when you're training hard and eating enough overall calories.

Spread it across your meals (around 20–40g per meal works well), hit your total, stay consistent, and you'll fuel those gains. Ain't nothin' but a peanut! 💪
